input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. Add what Shennong decides to do, so readers can understand his purpose. e.g. 他想：“我要找可以吃的植物。”
2. Add that he is surprised that different plants can make people feel so different. e.g. 他觉得很奇怪。
3. Add a small travel detail: he walks through many mountains to look for plants. e.g. 他走了很多山，找了很多植物。

ideas.reason: It gives Shennong a clear, story-fitting purpose for searching for plants.
It adds a fitting feeling about the different effects of the plants.
“走了很多山” is unnatural; “走过很多山” or “爬了很多山” would be better.
